proposer.model_feedback: all development metrics plus full-row evidence digest

rationale: Observe scene, parse object keys at last underscore to extract categories, identify baskets. Assign one basket per category in sorted order. Iteratively: reobserve, find first non-basket object not already inside a basket (within 0.2m of basket center) and not previously failed. Compute grasp z as object center z + half height + gripper_tool_offset_above_contact (0.125m). Approach with left arm downward quaternion, close gripper, lift 0.2m, approach assigned basket at basket_release_tool_z (1.01m), open gripper. Track failed items to prevent infinite loops. Bounded to 100 iterations well within 1100 step limit.
